coreAttributes.name: large portal ring
coreAttributes.description: A broad, rigid ring of arcane alloy, large enough to encircle a limb or the neck. When activated and linked to a remote portal, the limb or head that passes through appears to vanish entirely from this side — emerging instead at wherever the connected output portal is located. The effect is disorienting and intensely restrictive: a person wearing this on their arm cannot use that arm; one worn around the neck renders the wearer unable to speak or see their surroundings normally.

replacementText.self: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(slide)] the large portal ring into position. As the portal activates, the limb on the other side seems to vanish, leaving only the shimmering ring in its place.
replacementText.other: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(place)] the large portal ring onto [npc2.name]. The arcane aperture flares open and [npc2.her] limb appears to disappear into it.
replacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] roughly [npc.verb(force)] the large portal ring into place on [npc2.name].

displacementText.self: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(slide)] the large portal ring off, [npc.her] limb reappearing as the portal collapses.
displacementText.other: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(remove)] the large portal ring from [npc2.name], [npc2.her] displaced limb snapping back into existence.
displacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] roughly [npc.verb(yank)] the large portal ring off [npc2.name].
